text:
violet: quick sync on canary fallback interop. i want a compact decision model that operators can reason about and that the runtime/orchestrator can enforce without chatty traffic. thoughts?
omar: short version: lease + proof + score. runtime can take immediate protective action with a short lease and attach a proof blob (aggregates + seed). orchestrator validates proof and either upgrades to a cluster lease or cancels.
cheng: proof blob? keep it tiny. suggest: {window_ms, sample_count, p50, p95, error_rate, seed_hash}. hashed to avoid shipping raw traces.
elaine: also include a score vector so we can compute a canonical fallback_score server-side: e.g. score = w1*latency_z + w2*error + w3*model_conf_drop. weights come from cohort config.
orch-bot: deploybot: canary-run 2026-06-01T14:20Z started service=inference-gateway rev=canary-5c.
nate: operational risk: we need a clear precedence table. e.g., 1) orchestrator global ban, 2) orchestrator lease (high-priority), 3) runtime preempt lease (short ttl), 4) local transient action without lease. also consider human operator overrides which should be highest.
violet: agreed. also want backward compatibility: older runtimes that only emit simple FallbackEvent must still be respected. orchestrator should be able to synthesize a minimal proof from aggregated telemetry.
omar: design note: wire-format for FallbackEvent is json-lines with these flat fields: decision_id, cohort_id, source, lease_id?, ttl_ms, fallback_level, score, reason_code, sample_count, p50_ms, p95_ms, seed_hash, actionability, notes?. keep keys short to save bytes.
cheng: reason_code enum: LAT_P99, SERVE_ERR, KVS_SLOW, OOM, CONF_DROP. small set. plus a numeric code for quick filtering.
elaine: add an audit token: if runtime preempts due to an infra safety failure (OOM, security), include actor=runtime:emergency. Or operator-set actor like user:alice. helps for forensics.
orch-bot: alertbot: fallback_score spike detected in cohort=canary-5c at 14:22Z.
nate: testing requirements: simulation harness must be deterministic and support: (a) replay of recorded traffic, (b) synthetic signal injection (p99 spikes, kv latency), (c) RNG seed control so runs are reproducible, (d) orchestrator policy plugin so we can swap quorum/weights.
violet: good. add deterministic seed to proof blob so orchestrator can re-run local scoring to verify. seed_hash covers that.
omar: API decision: push RPC for SetFallback and RequestLease (gRPC mTLS) + a read endpoint GetDecisionStatus. also a fire-and-forget telemetry ingestion path (kinesis/stream) for the json-lines.
cheng: small protocol sketch: 
``` 
// SetFallback must be idempotent
rpc SetFallback(SetFallbackReq) returns (SetFallbackResp);
message SetFallbackReq { string decision_id; string cohort_id; int32 fallback_level; int64 expiry_ms; string actor; string proof_hash; }
```
orch-bot: note: rate-limit SetFallback to 2 calls/sec per-cluster; auth via mTLS and service tokens.
elaine: important tradeoff: runtime statefulness. if runtime keeps a tiny ephemeral ledger (last N decisions) we can reduce reconciliation chatter. but cost is complexity on upgrades. prefer ephemeral agent per node with robust upgrade story.
nate: simulation detail: harness should produce both the telemetry stream and the control-plane lookups (GetDecisionStatus) so we can validate race conditions. also produce a summary: flips, leases requested/granted, oscillation count.
violet: ops ergonomics: oncall wants human-friendly triage keys: short linkable reason + decision_id. include those in telemetry and in orchestration UI.
omar: also add a graceful degrade plan: fallback levels = NONE, REDUCE_BATCH, SMALLER_MODEL, CACHE_RESPONSES, REJECT. map to actions in runtime. document with examples.
cheng: implementation note: avoid GC pressure on runtimes for proof blobs. keep blobs <1KB. seed_hash + small aggregate fits.
elaine: action items: (1) omar + cheng: write the json-lines schema + example log-lines by Tue (2) nate: start deterministic sim harness repo + seed schema by Wed (3) violet: draft precedence matrix + human-override flow doc by Tue EOD (4) me: prototype small in-node ledger POC and measure upgrade smoothness.
nate: i'll include oscillation metrics and an auto-detection heuristic for thrash (e.g., >3 flips in 10m).
violet: one more: add a policy for cost-aware fallbacks: orchestrator can optionally annotate a decision with cost_impact so we can weigh latency vs spend when deciding to fallback. small int field.
omar: ok, add cost_impact_bucket (0-5).
orch-bot: info: canary-run 2026-06-01T14:30Z alert resolved for cohort=canary-5c.
cheng: closing: we'll reconvene after the first sim runs. thanks all.
